FEAT-6-S110.title: Consent Core Logic and Tier Enforcement Engine
FEAT-6-S110.description: Implement core consent decision engine within ConsentService to evaluate user state, assign Tier 1 vs Tier 2 consent, enforce de-identification for non-consented data, and control downstream data eligibility.

FEAT-6-S111.title: Consent Persistence and Storage Control Integration
FEAT-6-S111.description: Integrate consent decisions with MongoDB persistence layer to ensure only appropriately consented data is stored. Enforce storage rules for Tier 1 (de-identified only) and Tier 2 (identified with explicit consent), including audit fields.
